brief: Executive regional performance report with schematic 3D market view, attainment and display coverage, linked selection; clearly label schematic geography.
rules: Revenue and target are synthetic USD millions for one month; stock and weeklySales are units; WOS=stock/weeklySales; aggregate attainment and coverage use summed denominators. Select a market to reveal its metrics.

brief: Inventory risk dashboard, adjustable inbound scenario, WOS and exceptions; threshold above 12 weeks is high risk.
rules: Stock and inbound are units; weeklySales is units/week. Scenario WOS=(stock+inbound*multiplier)/weeklySales, multiplier 0–1, default 0; distinguish zero from missing.

brief: Interactive price waterfall with retail and distributor margins calculated on each party's selling price; freight and service paid by distributor.
rules: All values per unit; margin rates adjustable 0–0.4, default supplied values; show recalculated prices and contribution.

brief: Partner scorecard with equal weights across four metrics, no imputation, rank only complete records, show risk tradeoffs.
rules: Metrics are 0–100; arithmetic mean of four metrics; show missing explicitly; no ranking incomplete records.

brief: Readable cross-functional swimlane with branches, shared revision path, and resubmission loop.
rules: Preserve every directed edge and label; use lane ownership; provide node selection with incoming/outgoing transitions.

brief: Schematic exploded assembly with adjustable separation multiplier 0 to 2, reset to 1, all supplied dimensions and IDs preserved; not manufacturing drawing.
rules: Scale supplied offsets, not dimensions; default multiplier 1; label schematic and units.
